question: Who first observed ribosomes in the mid-1950s and described them as small particles in the cytoplasm that were preferentially attached to the endoplasmic reticulum membrane?
solution:
The correct answer is ** George Emi Palade**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Ribosomes were first observed in the mid-1950s by Romanian-American cell biologist **George** **Emil** **Palade**, using an electron microscope, as dense particles or granules.
 
• The ribosome is responsible for **synthesizing** **proteins** by translating the genetic code transcribed in mRNA into an amino acid sequence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2656bfa2c52919fc57008a58ddfe7db63091d613fcb6f6aabd341dc99a4ba4d1.png] 

 
• The **endoplasmic** **reticulum** is a part of a **transportation** **system** of the eukaryotic cell, and has many other important functions such as protein folding.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Cytoplasm is the gelatinous liquid that fills the inside of a cell.
 
• Its function is to transport, maintain cell shape and structure, protect, store macromolecules and act as the host to metabolic processes.
